job: Building a pre-install verification gate into the agent that checks package provenance and typosquat signals before any dependency install runs
outcome: A generally available, on-by-default check in at least two major coding agents that refuses to silently install packages failing verification
motivation: To stop the agent from being steered into fetching poisoned or typosquatted dependencies on the user's behalf

task.what: add pre-install provenance and typosquat verification gate
task.where: the agent's dependency install code path
task.why: block silent install of poisoned dependencies
task.how: PyPI attestations, npm Sigstore provenance, typosquat screening

job: Shipping and stabilizing the signed-provenance, trusted-publisher attestation, and typosquat-signal primitives that a coding agent can query before installing a dependency
outcome: Machine-consumable provenance and attestation endpoints on PyPI and npm that agents query at install time to verify a package
motivation: To close registry holes like mutable old releases so downstream agents inherit verifiable trust signals rather than blind names

task.what: expose provenance and attestation query endpoints
task.why: supply agents verifiable trust signals at install
task.how: Trusted Publishing, publish attestations, Sigstore provenance

job: Hardening the attestation and provenance-verification standards a coding agent relies on to decide whether an install is trustworthy across registries
outcome: Interoperable verification specs agents implement to check signed provenance and trusted-publisher attestations uniformly across PyPI, npm, and other registries
motivation: To make provenance verification interoperable enough that every major coding agent can adopt it on by default

task.why: enable default agent adoption of verification
